purpose: Test-only PEP-style discussion, explicitly excluding a final PEP. This is not a real GitHub conversation.

discussion.author: proposer
discussion.text: Proposal: add a process-wide mutable cache to accelerate plugin discovery.

discussion.author: reviewer
discussion.text: I reject the process-wide mutable cache because it leaks tenant data between independent interpreters. Consider an interpreter-local cache instead.

discussion.author: maintainer
discussion.text: Agreed: reject the process-wide cache due to tenant isolation. We will use an interpreter-local cache, with explicit invalidation on plugin reload.
